mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months indicates accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines over prior 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in federal funds rate and CPI increase above 3.0% signals stagflation where monetary easing fails to control inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines and CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a sustained unemployment rate decline below 5.0% for three consecutive months indicates tight labor markets that boost consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 5.0% for three consecutive months during late-cycle expansions, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits (HOUST) over the prior 3 months reflects strong housing market activity that correlates with higher consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST increases over prior 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When residential construction permits (HOUST) fall below 2000 thousand units for two consecutive months, it signals housing market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 2000 for two consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) over the prior 3 months indicates manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output and profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO declines over prior 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 95.0 for two consecutive months, it signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0 for two consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
